title: Review of the fed-vortex claim (SIDE) on fresh seeds 13 and 14 and a T=6000 run: division with sign kept continues to generation 19; the no-flow twin stops dividing; E holds by construction
summary: labkit runs of the claimed world (defaults, 128^2, 3 t frames) on fresh seeds 13 and 14 (T=3000), seed 13 to T=6000, the no-advection twin and the fuel fork on seed 13. Seeds 13/14: 44/45 persistent splits, generation 10/8, daughters keep the parent's sign at 39/40 and 43/43 splits with known sign, 33/29 splits after t=1000; same-sign fusions 78/60 vs opposite-sign 6/1 (merge/split 0.95/0.92). T=6000: 92 persistent splits, generation 19, 11-20 splits in every 1000 t window, population 26-34. No-advection twin: 12 persistent splits, all before t=771, then a frozen lattice of 54. Fuel fork at t=2000: 30 -> 0 bodies between t=2031 and t=2055.

observations.S: rerun/seed13/sheet.png t=0: band-passed random vorticity over the whole domain on uniform fuel; discrete vortices by t=126.
observations.I: rerun/seed13/sheet.png and rerun/long_seed13/sheet.png: 26-34 discrete round or oval vortices of both signs, each in its own fuel-depletion halo, persisting between collisions for hundreds of t (3 t frames) to t=6000.
observations.D: rerun/seed13/splits.json: 44 persistent splits, generation 10, daughters of the parent's sign at 39/40 with known sign; rerun/seed14/splits.json: 45, generation 8, 43/43. rerun/long_seed13/splits.json: 92 persistent splits, generation 19, with 11, 14, 20, 17, 13, 17 splits in successive 1000 t windows. rerun/noadv_seed13 (adv 0): 12 persistent splits, generation 2, last at t=771, then 54 frozen spots.
observations.E: rerun/fork_seed13/metrics.json series n_comp: 30 bodies at t=2028 (frame 676), 26/16/8/2/0 at t=2034/2040/2046/2052/2055 after the fuel is emptied at t=2000; the fed run (rerun/seed13) keeps 25-31.

seeds_run.result: pass: 44 persistent splits gen 10, twin 12 (all before t=771), fork 30 -> 0 in 55 t; T=6000: 92 splits gen 19
pass: 45 persistent splits, gen 8, sign kept 43/43

verdicts.limitation: E is build-from-food plus decay: vorticity grows only through the written gain k Y s omega and decays at mu, so the fork confirms it rather than discovers it. The gain term (k Y s - mu) omega is a local forcing written on the body field itself, not a physical fluid mechanism. The genealogy is reticulate: same-sign fusions outnumber persistent splits (merge/split ~0.9), and the late splits include long filaments cut into pieces (strips13.png at t=2889-2961). No resolution or dt test by me; 128^2 only.
